data.name: Donya
data.gender_notes: Donya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Donya refers to this material world that we live in, as opposed to the spiritual world (Akhira) that comes after it. It is a reminder for Muslims to focus on their spiritual growth while living in this world. The name Donya carries the meaning “The World” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Donya usually hope their child will grow to embody the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the transient nature of this world and the importance of focusing on spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Donya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Donya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Instead, Muslims should strive to find a balance between living in the Donya and focusing on their spiritual development for the Akhira.
